title: Crossroads of Destiny
next_chapter_hook: In the instant Chen Ji pressed the activation key for the final showdown, deep within the Void, a vertical eye spanning countless ages slowly opened—the existence that surpassed Heavenly Dao, for the first time casting its gaze upon this insignificant chess piece.

text.content:
Two strands of Heavenly Fate frantically intertwined in the Void, and Chen Ji felt his consciousness being torn into millions of fragments. He saw the past, saw the future, saw the pieces he had meticulously arranged falling into position one by one—but simultaneously, he also witnessed his own destiny about to dissipate.

The fragments of the Tianji Record wildly trembled within his Mental Sea, those sealed characters like living tadpoles burning pathways through the depths of his soul. Pain, excruciating pain, yet at the end of this pain lay an unprecedented clarity.

"So that's it..." At the moment his consciousness was about to shatter, Chen Ji finally grasped that fleeting inspiration. "The method of awakening isn't about seizing—it's about resonance!"

In the instant before Heavenly Fate was about to be completely stripped away, the dormant Twin Bond within Chen Ji suddenly erupted. A warm and familiar force surged from the depths of the Void—that was Chen Nian, his sister missing for years, acting as the Heavenly Fate Key, transmitting the light of life across countless mountains and rivers.

Two strands of light merged within the Mental Sea, and chaos began to separate.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, bathed in blood, yet his eyes burned with unprecedented brilliance. He lowered his head to look at his own hands—the patterns of the Tianji Record had completely fused with his bloodline, impossible to separate again.

"It's done." He said softly, his voice hoarse but firm. "The third path—opens."

dialogue.content:
"You chose the hardest path." The remnant soul of Mo Xiansheng's voice came from the depths of his Mental Sea, carrying a trace of imperceptible relief. "Those who break the shackles either become new shackles, or perish together with the shackles—there is no third possibility."

Chen Ji slowly stood up and surveyed his surroundings. The secret Forbidden Grounds of the Tianqing Sect were arranged with formations he had personally drawn; the spies from the three great sects had already been turned against; even the Holy Sect's Saint of the Demonic Path was currently concealing his Heavenly Secrets aura.

"So I need to become Heavenly Dao." Chen Ji stated calmly, as if commenting on pleasant weather.

text.content:
Within the Mental Sea, the full scope of the Tianji Record presented itself before Chen Ji for the first time. He saw the fate trajectories of all past prophecy-seers, saw how the Eye of Heavenly Dao manipulated every "chess piece"—including himself.

But he also saw a hidden pathway.

"All past prophecy-seers tried to break the shackles, which is why they failed." Chen Ji murmured to himself, a cold smile appearing at the corner of his mouth. "Because they were all fighting within the shackles. And I—"

He abruptly raised his head, eyes blazing with brilliant light.

"I will stand outside the chessboard and remake the rules."

Integration. He began integrating all his gains.

Tianji Realm—he had stepped into that legendary domain, able to vaguely perceive the threads of destiny; the awakening method—he had mastered it, not by seizing Heavenly Fate, but by resonating with it; the Twin Bond—Chen Nian's power acted like an anchor, binding him tightly to this heaven and earth; the sect layout—the Tianqing Sect, Xuanwu Sect, Vermillion Bird Sect, the key positions in all three great sects had already been seeded with his pieces.

And there was the Demonic Path. Holy Sect Saint Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist currently shrouded the entire Forbidden Grounds, concealing his Heavenly Secrets.

All of this was pointing toward the same endpoint.

dialogue.content:
"Two paths." Chen Ji spoke to the Void, as if conversing with some unseen existence, or perhaps persuading himself. "Path A, break the shackles, release all prophecy-seers oppressed by Heavenly Dao, let this heaven and earth return to freedom—the cost is I might be destroyed together with the shackles."

He paused, his voice dropping.

"Path B, replace Heavenly Dao and become the new chess player. I make the rules, I decide who lives and who dies—the cost is I must bear all the karma accumulated by past Heavenly Dao, including the grievances of the innocent."

Silence.

"Is there a third path?" He嘲讽地笑了笑, "There is. But that requires a miracle."

choice.prompt: At the crossroads of destiny, Chen Ji must make his final choice. This moment, he will decide his own fate, and also the fate of all beings under heaven.

choices.text: Breaking the Shackles · The Martyr's Path
choices.description: Choose to perish together with the shackles, releasing all trapped souls. This is the path of heroes, and also the most tragic ending.
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Dao collapses, all beings are free
choices.risk_hint: Extremely likely to dissipate before success

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling the surging Heavenly Fate power within his body. He had already prepared himself for death. But just as he was about to ignite his own Heavenly Fate core—

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji!" A cold and clear voice came from the distance, carrying irrepressible anxiety. Su Qingyao's figure appeared at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds, her robes stained with blood, clearly having fought her way through.

"What are you doing?!" She rushed to his side, her usually aloof face full of panic. "Who do you think you are? Is being a lone hero shouldering everything?"

choices.text: Replacing Heavenly Dao · The New Chess Player's Path
choices.description: Choose to become the new Heavenly Dao, establishing new rules. This path is lonely and bloody, but at least he can survive.
choices.visible_cost: Bear the karma of generations, lose part of humanity
choices.risk_hint: Possibly be counteracted by Heavenly Dao's will

text.content: Chen Ji opened his eyes, a trace of resolve flickering within. He began operating the Tianji Record, connecting his consciousness with the Heavenly Dao network spanning countless ages. Tens of thousands of billions of causal threads flooded into his Mental Sea, each representing a life, each choice consuming his Heavenly Fate Value—

dialogue.content:
"Are you insane?" A yin and soft voice rang out from the shadows. Ye Qing appeared stepping through demonic mist, her expression complex and unreadable. "Do you know what taking over Heavenly Dao means? You will become its successor—a monster that only knows to maintain order."

She stepped forward, setting aside the Saint's arrogance for the first time: "I helped you, not for you to become another tyrant."

choices.text: The Third Path · The Path of Miracles
choices.description: Combine A and B into one, performing the act of seizing power with a martyr's heart. No one has ever walked this path—the probability of success: zero.
choices.visible_cost: Bearing the combined weight of two prices simultaneously
choices.visible_reward: True freedom, unbound by any rules
choices.risk_hint: A path no one has walked before, unknown dangers

text.content:
Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then suddenly burst into laughter. That smile carried a hint of madness, yet remained utterly clear.

"You're all mistaken." He spoke deliberately. "Why must breaking chains and supplanting Heaven's mandate be mutually exclusive?"

He spread his arms wide, the complete Tianji Record unfurling behind him like a scroll spanning countless epochs.

"I intend to shatter the chains while simultaneously supplanting them! Not by becoming a new constraint, but by embodying the very force that dismantles all constraints!"

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng's fragmented soul quivered violently: "Impossible... Every prophet throughout history has failed at this precise juncture... Have you lost your mind?!"

"I'm certainly insane." Chen Ji replied with perfect calm. "How else could one carve out an unprecedented path?"

Flames blazed within his gaze, his voice low yet unyielding: "And besides, I have all of you."

text.content:
Su Qingyao and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, the air crackling with peculiar tension. One was the Inner Sect's senior fellow, the other the Holy Sect's sacred maiden - yet both now stood behind Chen Ji.

"Do you comprehend what this means?" Su Qingyao was the first to speak, her voice trembling slightly. "Should you fail, everyone connected to you will face Heaven's retribution - myself, the Tianqing Sect, even Chen Nian included."

Ye Qing let out a cold laugh: "Including everyone in my Holy Sect. That debt far exceeds anything the Demon Path owes you."

Chen Ji regarded these two women with contrasting dispositions, unexpectedly experiencing warmth flooding his heart. He reflected on his initial acquisition of the Tianji Record - a time when he was merely a Disposable Disciple/Servant, helpless and alone, with no one to rely upon.

But now, he had comrades fighting shoulder to shoulder.

"That's precisely why I must succeed." He murmured, his voice carrying unprecedented resolve. "For your sake, for Chen Nian, for those souls trampled by Heaven for millennia - I must succeed."

He raised his gaze, his eyes piercing through the Forbidden Grounds' dome toward the inaccessible depths of the Void.

"Initiate." He declared. "The final confrontation - begins."

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao drew a deep breath, suppressing her turbulent emotions. Stepping to Chen Ji's side, she stood shoulder to shoulder with him, her robes billowing in the Void.

"I always knew something was amiss with you." She suddenly spoke, her tone composed yet layered with complex sentiment. "Three years I've been investigating you. Every time I believed I'd caught your weakness, the final moment always slipped away."

She turned her head, meeting his eyes directly for the first time: "Now I finally understand - it wasn't that I lacked evidence. You wouldn't let me have evidence. Chen Ji, what exactly am I to you?"

Chen Ji fell silent for a heartbeat, then softly answered: "A companion."

"Companion?" Su Qingyao's brow furrowed.

"Initially, a chess piece." Chen Ji acknowledged without evasion, meeting her gaze. "But that changed long ago. You're too intelligent, too steadfast - three years of approaching the truth yet being deflected three times. Such an adversary merits respect."

He paused: "Later, you became the only person I wished not to deceive. So I constructed scheme after scheme, causing you to lose the thread at the crucial moment each time. Not to exploit you, but to—"

He didn't finish, yet Su Qingyao already understood his meaning.

"What a touching scene." Ye Qing's voice chimed in from the side, dripping with mockery yet unable to conceal the envy in her eyes. "Forbidden affection between the Inner Sect's senior fellow and a Disposable Disciple/Servant - tsk tsk, if the Tianqing Sect learned of this, who knows what they'd think."

Su Qingyao regarded her with glacial detachment: "If you don't speak, no one mistakes you for mute."

"Me?" Ye Qing giggled, her smile carrying an undercurrent of bitterness. "I'm merely envious. At least you can stand by his side openly. As for me—"

She raised her palm, gazing at the churning demonic mist: "How many innocents' blood stains these hands, even I cannot count."

choice.prompt: The final confrontation is about to commence, yet these two women's emotional barriers remain unbreached. Chen Ji must provide them with an answer - or perhaps a solemn pledge - before activating the mechanism.

choices.description: Su Qingyao has waited three years for this answer. It's time to offer her a formal response - regardless of the outcome, she deserves candid treatment.
choices.visible_cost: Ye Qing might consequently drift away
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao's affection significantly increases, unlocking the prerequisite conditions for 「Shared Destiny」

text.content:
Chen Ji turns toward Su Qingyao, his gaze gentle yet earnest: "Qingyao, these past three years have been arduous for you."

"What are you—" Su Qingyao hadn't yet grasped his meaning.

Chen Ji extended his hand, gently clasping hers. Her fingers were ice-cold and trembling, but when his warmth permeated through, the trembling ceased.

"When this concludes—" he gazed intently into her eyes, "there are words I must share with you."

choices.memory_label: 陈机承诺战后有话要说

choices.description: Ye Qing bears a burden of sin heavier than anyone; she needs a reason to live more than anyone else. Chen Ji must provide her with an answer.

text.content:
Chen Ji turns to Ye Qing, his voice composed yet commanding: "That blood - it was never your desire to shed."

Ye Qing's body stiffened.

"You were manipulated by the Holy Sect, compelled to commit those acts - yet your heart has never genuinely belonged to them." Chen Ji met her gaze directly. "Otherwise, the Tianji Record's prophecy would never have manifested through you."

He extended his hand: "When this concludes, I will help you absolve those transgressions. Not through death, but through your remaining years - performing genuinely meaningful deeds for those innocent souls."

choices.memory_label: 陈机承诺帮夜清洗清罪孽

text.content:
In the instant Chen Ji prepares his response, the entire Forbidden Grounds convulses violently. A massive fissure rends the sky, and a vertical eye spanning countless epochs emerges from the tear, gazing down at the three below with glacial detachment.

This is no ordinary observation - it is the Eye of Heaven.

Chen Ji's very blood turns to ice. He perceives an overwhelming pressure beyond comprehension, an irresistible will emanating from those penetrating eyes.

"It's awakened." Mo Xiansheng's voice carries unprecedented terror. "The Tianji Record's fluctuations have roused it - it's stirring from its ancient slumber!"

dialogue.content:
A resonant proclamation reverberates across heaven and earth, devoid of emotional inflection yet inspiring primal dread in every soul:

"Tianji Record... at last, a complete wielder has emerged."

That vertical pupil shifts minutely, targeting Chen Ji's precise location.

"Every prophet across history has attempted to shatter the chains, yet hilariously, the chains themselves constitute their very purpose." The voice persists. "And you, Chen Ji - are the most impeccable chess piece I have awaited for millennia."

Chen Ji feels an ethereal force attempting to infiltrate his Mental Sea, Heaven's indomitable will directly assaulting his spiritual essence.

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his teeth, the Tianji Record madly circulating within his body, barely repelling the invading force. But he felt his Heavenly Fate Value plummeting—ten points, twenty points, thirty points... "You think you can resist?" the Heavenly Eye coldly laughed, "The rules of this heaven and earth are set by me. Every thought you have, every breath you take, every drop of blood in you—I monitor it all. How could you possibly win?" Chen Ji's consciousness began to blur, yet he refused to give up. He desperately stabilized his mind, beginning to construct a precise formation within his Mental Sea—the final trump card he had been arranging for ten years. "Mo Xiansheng," he called out in his heart, "Activate—the Heavenly Fate Resonance Formation!"

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye had already begun its counterattack. Chen Ji had to make his final deployment within three breaths. The Heavenly Fate Resonance Formation required enormous energy support, and he needed to decide the source of that energy.

choices.text: Using one's own Heavenly Fate as the price

choices.visible_reward: Activating the resonance formation to directly confront the Heavenly Will
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, possible instant death

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. He pushed the Tianji Record to its absolute limit, beginning to burn his Heavenly Fate core. Vast energy erupted from within him, forming a dazzling halo around his body. "Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao cried out in horror, reaching out to pull him back. "Don't come near!" Chen Ji roared, "This formation requires all the energy—once interrupted, everything will be wasted—" But at this moment, a familiar force suddenly descended from the depths of the Void, stable and warm—that was the other end of the twin bond, Chen Nian.

choices.description: Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and Chen Ji share the energy together. This is the highest risk plan, but also the highest success rate.
choices.visible_cost: All three injured simultaneously, relationships permanently bound
choices.visible_reward: Resonance formation power doubled, success rate increased to eighty percent
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, three advance together

text.content: "Together." Su Qingyao did not wait for Chen Ji's answer, directly pressing her palm against his back. Ye Qing hesitated for a moment, then wore a relieved smile, placing her hand on Su Qingyao's shoulder. The energy of all three merged at this moment, forming a perfect cycle. "I've wanted to do this for a long time," Ye Qing murmured, "Dying together with a righteous sect disciple and this waste—nobody would believe it if we told them." Su Qingyao snorted coldly: "Who said anything about dying?" Chen Ji felt the warmth flowing from both of them, an unprecedented warmth rising in his heart. The Heavenly Fate Resonance Formation completely took shape at this moment, blooming with light brilliant enough to tear apart the heavens.

choices.description: Through the twin bond, drawing Chen Nian's Heavenly Fate Key power over. This is the plan with the highest chance of victory, but will expose Chen Nian's location.
choices.visible_cost: Chen Nian's location exposed, may be pursued by the Holy Sect
choices.visible_reward: Heavenly Fate Key power injected, success rate increased to ninety percent
choices.risk_hint: Extremely high risk, but miracles may occur

text.content: Chen Ji closed his eyes, completely sinking his consciousness into the twin bond. He sensed Chen Nian in the distance—his sister, the Heavenly Fate Key taken by the Holy Sect, was enduring unimaginable pain. But when her consciousness touched Chen Ji's, that pain transformed into determination. "Brother..." Chen Nian's voice rang in his Mental Sea, tearful yet utterly resolute, "I knew you would come for me... use my power, it's okay..." A torrential force of the Key erupted from the depths of the Void, perfectly merging with the Heavenly Fate Resonance Formation. The Heavenly Eye let out an angry roar—it had finally realized Chen Nian's existence. "No—! That Key is mine! Return it to me!"

The Heavenly Fate Resonance Formation, supported by the power of three people (or four if including Chen Nian), fully activated. A brilliant pillar of light shot skyward, piercing directly toward that vertical pupil spanning countless ages. The Heavenly Eye roared in fury: "A mere ant dares to fight against heaven!" But Chen Ji simply raised his head calmly, gazing at that enormous eye, his voice devoid of any emotion: "I am not fighting you." The pillar of light collided with the Heavenly Eye, producing a deafening roar. The entire Tianqing Sect trembled, the territories of the three major sects quaked, and even cracks appeared in the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds. "I am telling you—" Chen Ji's voice pierced through the chaos, clearly entering the ears of every living being: "From this day forward, the rules of this heaven and earth—I shall determine."

In that moment, the vertical pupil of the Heavenly Eye violently contracted. It sensed the terror of that power—not merely rebellion, but the birth of another possibility. "You..." its voice trembled for the first time, "What do you intend to do?!" Chen Ji did not answer. He pushed the Tianji Record to its absolute limit, allowing that prophetic power spanning countless ages to collide head-on with the Heavenly Will. Trillions of causality threads snapped in the collision, and countless oppressed souls gained brief freedom at this moment. But this was only the beginning. Because the instant the pillar of light pierced through the Heavenly Eye, countless even more powerful auras awakened from the depths of the Void. Those auras were ancient and terrifying, far exceeding the level of the Heavenly Eye. "Interesting..." an aged voice drifted from the Void, carrying playful amusement, "The first ant in ten thousand years to dare challenge the Heavenly Dao—let's see how far you can go."

Chen Ji's expression finally changed. He sensed them—those auras, those terrifying existences far beyond the Heavenly Eye. They had always hidden in the depths of the Void, in higher dimensional spaces, gazing down upon everything in this heaven and earth. Including the Heavenly Eye itself. "So that's how it is..." Chen Ji murmured, a trace of bitter laughter in his voice, "The Heavenly Eye isn't the final boss... it's merely a chess piece too." Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in his Mental Sea, carrying unprecedented gravity: "Chen Ji, you have now touched the true forbidden realm. Those existences... are the Heavenly Will itself." "And I am merely their tool for managing this heaven and earth." Chen Ji closed his eyes, took a deep breath, then reopened them. His eyes held no fear, only cold determination. "Then let this tool—completely lose control."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji abruptly turned his head, looking at Su Qingyao and Ye Qing. "The situation is more complicated than anticipated." His voice was calm, yet carried undeniable resolve, "I originally thought defeating the Heavenly Eye would end everything—now it seems the true enemy still lies ahead." He paused, a bitter smile appearing at the corner of his mouth: "This is probably what they call... the failure of playing pig to eat the tiger." Su Qingyao and Ye Qing simultaneously rolled their eyes. "Are you still joking at a time like this?" Su Qingyao said impatiently, but her hand remained tightly pressed against Chen Ji's back, not loosening. Ye Qing coldly said: "I always knew following you would bring no good fortune. But—" She wore a dangerous smile: "Since we're all going to die anyway, what's wrong with going crazy with you one last time?"

text.content: Chen Ji looked at these two women with entirely different personalities yet equally unwavering determination, an indescribable emotion rising in his heart. Is this the fruit he had accumulated over ten years of scheming? Not power, not resources, but— "Trust." he said quietly. Neither Su Qingyao nor Ye Qing spoke, but their eyes had already explained everything. Chen Ji took a deep breath, concealed all emotions, and became once again that coldly terrifying strategist who left nothing to chance. "Next, I need you both to do one thing." he said, his voice returning to its usual平淡, "While I confront those existences, guard this place for me." He raised his head, gazing at the sky that was cracking apart. "The final battle—only now truly begins."

Just as Chen Ji was about to step into the Void, a sharp pain suddenly pierced his chest. A familiar and warm force surged from the Blood Twin Link, stable and resolute.

Chen Nian.

Her voice rang in his mind, clear and gentle: "Brother, I'm here."

Chen Ji closed his eyes, feeling that connection from the depths of his bloodline. He remembered ten years ago, that little girl crying her heart out when the Holy Sect took her away; he remembered that night he swore he would find her no matter what.

Now, she had finally returned.

"Wait for me." He responded in his heart, "When all this is over, we'll go home."

Then, he opened his eyes and stepped into the Void.

There, the remnants of the Heavenly Dao's Eye were still dissipating, and the gazes of those higher beings had already locked onto this tiny ant who dared to challenge the Heavenly Dao.

The horn of the final showdown—officially sounded.
